user.title: GLaDOS
user.description:
Add GLaDOS to this home. She will be unbearable about it.

Pick the chat agent she thinks with. Voices, sounds and the speaking schedule are under Configure afterwards. Then choose GLaDOS as the conversation agent of your voice assistant.

data_description.chat_agent: The conversation agent she thinks with, such as an Ollama, OpenAI, Google or Anthropic agent with Assist control on. Not GLaDOS itself.
data_description.personality: Sends her GLaDOS persona along with every request. Turn it off only if the chat agent's own prompt already makes it GLaDOS.
data_description.home_town: Where the house is, for her remarks and local searches. Optional.

abort.single_instance_allowed: GLaDOS is already installed. One is plenty.

init.title: GLaDOS

brain.name: Brain
brain.description: The agent she thinks with, her personality and the agent that rewrites announcements.

data_description.chat_agent: The conversation agent she thinks with, such as an Ollama, OpenAI, Google or Anthropic agent with Assist control on. Not GLaDOS itself.
data_description.personality: Sends her GLaDOS persona along with every request. Turn it off only if the chat agent's own prompt already makes it GLaDOS.
data_description.home_town: Where the house is, for her remarks and local searches. Optional.
data_description.voice_agent: A separate agent that rewrites announcements in her voice. Empty: the chat agent does it.
data_description.house_notes: What only this house knows, in a few short sentences: pets, nicknames for devices, habits. Added to her tool instructions.
data_description.live_house: Gives her a short live summary with every request: who is home and where, each room's climate, open windows, the weather, alarms, leave times and the next calendar items. Turn off if the chat agent's own prompt already has a live list.

voices.name: Voices and sounds
voices.description: The facility Announcer's voice, the beeps, and when she may speak up unprompted.

data_description.announcer_voice: The facility Announcer's text-to-speech voice, as engine:voice, such as tts.piper:announcer. Empty: her own voice reads the notices.
data_description.beep_in: Media id played before she speaks, such as media-source://media_source/local/beep-in.mp3. Empty: no beep.
data_description.beep_out: Media id played after she speaks. Empty: no beep.
data_description.speaking_schedule: She only speaks up unprompted while this schedule is on. Empty: any time, still never while someone sleeps.

warnings.name: Air and window warnings
warnings.description: CO2 in every room with a sensor, and windows left open in the cold.

data_description.co2_alerts: Warn in the room when the air goes stale (1000 ppm) or critical (1500 ppm), and when a window stays open in the cold. Announcer: the facility Announcer warns and GLaDOS replies. GLaDOS: she warns on her own.
data_description.co2_reminder_minutes: Remind again after this many minutes while the air stays bad. 0: no reminder.
data_description.cold_outside_below: Below this outside temperature, a window open for 20 minutes gets a reminder, once per opening; in an empty room, she tells whoever is home.

initiative.name: Her own initiative
initiative.description: Offering heat or cooling, rare facility notices, and one unprompted remark a day.

data_description.comfort_offers: When someone has settled in a room that is too cold or warm and its heater or cooler is off, she asks whether to switch it on and listens for yes or no. A no holds for the day.
data_description.cold_below: Room temperature below which she offers heat.
data_description.warm_above: Room temperature above which she offers cooling.
data_description.settled_minutes: Minutes in a room before she offers, so not for someone passing through.
data_description.facility_notices: Rare, true notices by the Announcer (at most one every three days), and once a night an hour past bedtime with the lights on.
data_description.idle_remarks: Once a day at a random moment, one unprompted remark about what is going on.

days.name: Reminders, alarms and leaving
days.description: Reminders read out, the heads-up before leaving, and the backup for phone alarms.

data_description.reminders: To-dos with a due time on each person's own list and the shared To-do list, said in their room when due, or sent to their phone. What comes due while they sleep goes to the phone and is also said after they wake. Turn off if an automation already does this.
data_description.leave_heads_up_minutes: Minutes before a person's leave time that the Announcer gives a heads-up. At the time itself it says leave now, with what is still on and open. 0: only leave now.
data_description.routine_minutes: Minutes from alarm to the door, for people without their own Morning routine helper.
data_description.alarm_backup_minutes: A morning alarm on a phone that has not been dismissed by then, or a phone that is off or never showed the alarm, rings on the room's speaker.
data_description.welcome_home: Coming home after at least an hour away: how long they were gone, the reminders that came due while they were out, and what is still on or open.

nights.name: Mornings and bedtime
nights.description: The morning greeting and birthdays, and each person's bedtime.

data_description.morning_greeting: After a morning alarm, once they are out of bed, or the first time a light goes on in their room: the Announcer's "in suspension for" line, then GLaDOS with the morning briefing. Lights labelled glados_wakeup fade on while it is dark. Turn off if an automation already does this.
data_description.birthday_song: Media id played before the birthday greeting, such as media-source://media_source/local/birthday.mp3. Empty: no song.
data_description.birthday_names: Other names a person's birthday appears under in the calendar, as person: names; such as nico: Sjors, Nico; byte: Bee. Their own name always counts.
data_description.bedtime_nudges: Per person, in their room: an hour before bedtime, at bedtime, and the Announcer's last call when the lights are still on. Bedtime is their next morning alarm minus the sleep goal. Turn off if an automation already says these.
data_description.sleep_goal_hours: Hours of sleep before a morning alarm: sets bedtime.
data_description.minimum_sleep_hours: Hours of sleep below which it is last call.
data_description.usual_bedtime: Bedtime on nights without a morning alarm. Empty: no nudges then.
data_description.bedtime_sensor: Optional: a timestamp sensor with the time to be asleep, mentioned in the bedtime briefing.

init.description: Everything she does, grouped. Only Brain is open by default.

clean_text.name: Clean text for speech
clean_text.description: Makes text safe for the text-to-speech voice: emoji, quotes and markdown removed, units and minus signs spelled out.

say.name: Say in her voice
say.description: Rewrites plain facts in GLaDOS's voice and cleans them for speech. Falls back to the facts.

task.name: Task
task.description: An extra job, such as adding a clothing tip.

room_context.name: Room context
room_context.description: Everything about one room: people, occupancy, sleep, quiet, climate, windows, heaters, coolers and free voice satellites.

area.name: Area
area.description: Empty for the room people are in.

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Says something unprompted in the right room, only when polite. GLaDOS rewrites the facts; the Announcer reads them as written.

area.name: Area
area.description: Room to speak in. Empty: where people are.

ignore_schedule.name: Ignore schedule
ignore_schedule.description: Speak outside the speaking schedule. Sleep and quiet rules still apply.

anywhere.name: Any room if none here
anywhere.description: Use a free satellite elsewhere when the room has none.

glados_after.name: GLaDOS chimes in
glados_after.description: With the Announcer: a task for one GLaDOS remark right after.

satellite.name: Satellite
satellite.description: Speak on this satellite, whatever room it is in. Empty: the room's own.

who.name: Who
who.description: Works out which person is meant (a name, the user asking, or the only one home) and returns their room, phones, leave time, routine minutes and own list.

person.name: Person
person.description: Name; empty for the person asking.

remember.name: Remember
remember.description: Stores one value under a key, with the time it was stored.

recall.name: Recall
recall.description: Returns a remembered value and when it was stored.

test_announcement.name: Test announcement
test_announcement.description: Plays the CO2 warning once, as it would sound: the beeps, the voices and the lines, for the room's real reading or a pretend one. Still quiet while someone sleeps.

satellite.name: Satellite
satellite.description: Where to play it. Empty: the room people are in.

co2.name: Pretend CO2
co2.description: Use this reading instead of the room's real one, such as 1500 for the critical warning.

style.name: Style
style.description: announcer (the Announcer warns, GLaDOS replies) or glados (she warns alone).

reminder.name: Reminder
reminder.description: Play the reminder that follows when the air stays bad.

briefing.name: Briefing
briefing.description: The bedtime briefing for tomorrow, or with morning on, the rest of today: calendar, alarms, leave times, phones that need charging, bedtime and weather. Returns the facts and, unless plain, the two or three that matter in her voice.

morning.name: Morning
morning.description: The rest of today instead of tomorrow.

area.name: Area
area.description: For the people in this room. Empty: everyone at home.

plain.name: Plain facts
plain.description: Only the facts, for an automation that voices them itself.

greet.name: Greet
greet.description: The morning greeting for one person now, as it would sound. Greets again even if they were greeted today.

person.name: Person
person.description: Name; empty for the person asking.

area.name: Area
area.description: Room to greet in. Empty: where they are.
